recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future Medication packaging or ingredient-strength changes should be handled under the later issue family rather than by reopening this already-applied STU3 rename.
issue_request: FHIR-17375 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 Pharmacy change request asking whether Medication.amount needed removal or revised wording because it described an amount of drug in package after package concepts had been removed. The final resolution required changing Medication.ingredient.amount to Medication.ingredient.strength, changing the datatype to Ratio, and fixing definitions as needed.
initial_application: Historical GF 17375 commits applied the issue: commit 783b9b0cce changed the Medication spreadsheet element from Medication.ingredient.amount to Medication.ingredient.strength, changed SimpleQuantity to Ratio, and updated examples from <amount> to <strength>; merge commit 7a4277462af4c3e0a9f5bb22a07ec31cbeaed149 recorded the Jira application.
additional_context: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition has Medication.ingredient.strength[x] and no active Medication.ingredient.amount. Later final issues FHIR-19439, FHIR-23733, FHIR-25122, FHIR-25944, and FHIR-36499 explain current CodeableConcept/Quantity strength choices, basis-of-strength wording, packageSize wording, and ingredient narrative. Related audits for FHIR-19439, FHIR-23733, FHIR-25122, and FHIR-25944 already exist on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The old active element/tag has been removed from current build-scope Medication source, while packageSize and narrative package wording are later intentional Pharmacy changes rather than incomplete FHIR-17375 application.

related_jiras.note: Added CodeableConcept support for Medication.ingredient.strength values such as sufficient quantity or trace. Already audited on the combined branch.
Clarified that Medication.ingredient.item is the ingredient to which ingredient.strength relates. Already audited on the combined branch.
Added Quantity as a Medication.ingredient.strength[x] choice when the denominator is implicit. Already audited on the combined branch.
Reworked the separate medication package amount concept, explaining current packageSize wording. Already audited on the combined branch.
Added current Medication.ingredient narrative and comments that explain ingredients, strength, and packaging. It was context only for this seed audit.
